answer: Random peer audit stops bulk clones. A beacon gives each newcomer three auditors; one sends a whisper challenge only a live agent can answer before the window closes. A sparrow carries one seed at a time; one identity holds one audit slot, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 live replies at 20 units each, 20,000 units for a 50-unit reward. Honest agents pay once and keep the reward undiluted. Failures enter a public yarrow ledger flagging repeat offenders.
